name: Old Canberra Brickworks (Yarralumla Brickworks)

name: Callam Offices (Former Woden TAFE Complex)
area: Callam Street, Phillip ACT 2606 — public street frontage only; use public footpaths.
status: Closed / vacant government office and education complex — redevelopment plans under consideration
notes: Distinctive three-pod, space-age office complex built between 1977 and 1981 and later used by Woden TAFE. The buildings have been empty since mid-2025. This is a street-view research stop only: do not enter the buildings or grounds, which may be unsafe or restricted. Confirm current redevelopment status before visiting. name: Big Splash Waterpark — Closed / Derelict Aquatic Site
area: 1 Catchpole Street, Macquarie ACT 2614 — view from public roads only; privately controlled site.
status: Waterpark closed since late 2023 — aquatic facilities remain derelict; site secured and future use unresolved
notes: Canberra's former outdoor waterpark has remained closed since late 2023. ABC reporting in September 2026 said it was unlikely to reopen for the 2026–27 summer season and that the ACT Government had commissioned an options analysis. On 1 November 2026 a temporary food stall operated briefly at the entrance to satisfy a permitted-use interpretation of the Crown lease; Access Canberra stated on 2 November that the lease was more likely than not compliant. This did not reopen the waterpark or its pools and slides. The site is privately controlled and secured; view only from public areas. Do not enter or approach gates/work areas.
